name: Fake SAGA Token
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.79). Replaced keyword guess "social-engineering".
rootCause: A counterfeit SAGA token on BNB Chain was used in an April 2024 rug pull that drained roughly 1.59 million USDT from PancakeSwap liquidity. Available evidence shows a wallet linked to the token approving and transferring a very large token balance before receiving 1,592,169 USDT in the same transaction. The incident was an impersonation rug pull involving a fake SAGA-branded token on BNB Chain. Wallets associated with the deployer retained overwhelming control of the token supply and sold into PancakeSwap liquidity after attracting buyers during the legitimate Saga launch period.
